resources.string: Nothing seeded. Every arm looks the same on a fully fogged map, so seed a walk before comparing.

The local walk is a fixed synthetic route — a curved corridor, a loop that crosses itself and a detached island — around your current location, or around a public park in Taipei if the device will not give one. Compare arms on that one. The worldwide fixture writes about 307,000 points scattered over the planet to load the database; its anchors are nowhere near you, so it leaves your own screen fogged. Both replace whatever was seeded before, are marked as mock, and are removed by Clear.
